_doc: The three Living Earth shots of the mix (MIX.md), as parameters. Read by remotion/src/blocking/le.ts (the cameras) and living_earth/render_le.sh (the frame ranges, via living_earth/le_frames.py + timing/timing_v0.yaml). Times are anchors in the timing file's grammar; the engine's own song clock (SceneTimeline) uses the same provisional grid, so section-relative keys line up until the take re-times both.

LE0.title: H1 'Her, first' (hook30, her OK Sat Nov 7): the prologue, her night network full frame, one light leaving; the pull-back dries into the pencil circle of the title page (wet-edge dissolve in build/hook30_h1/hook_h1.py)
LE0.netGain_note: the night network's gain for this shot (BlockingFilm's constant is 0.9; Film.tsx's final-chorus level is ~1.2). At song time 0 the network would be at its dimmest; the prologue runs it at the final-chorus level.
LE0.end_note: the approved bloom key is intro+0.3 .. intro+2.0+0.3 (4.8-9.4 s); the render must outlive the dissolve, so the shot ends at intro+2.2 (10.19 s, 306 frames), not the pitch's intro+1.2
LE0.pulses_note: the prologue's own network pulses (the final chorus's grammar: a front, a 2-3 s tail), keyed to the timing map; `at` = anchor; lat/lon as chorus 1's (the Congo, the Tagus, the Amazon). Read by le.ts lePulses().
LE0.keys_note: her-centre keys like LE3. The cold open holds the approved H1_a framing (la 0.90) and starts the pull; through the intro the pull-back runs to la 2.10, where her disc is the pencil circle of the title page (R 330 at (1265, 720) in the 1440p frame: sx 0.494, sy 0.50; angular radius asin(1/e^2.1) at fov 30), reached at intro+1.2 and held while the render dries into the paint (to intro+2.2).

LE1.title: chorus-1 terminator plate: the photograph tipped into Plate IV ('fig. 4: you, riding my dusk line')
LE1.camera_note: the blocking's own chorus-1 camera: C1-D's landing on 'chase' (her half-lit disc, the gold line lower-left to upper-right, him hung near the lens) through the glint on 'disappear'. Nothing new to key.
LE1.frames_note: mounted in a 1150x670 photo in the 1440p page; 1080p is plenty

LE2.title: C01, her sunrise: the full-page photograph of chorus 2 (and Short 2's loop)
LE2.camera_note: the blocking's chorus-2 camera as approved for the hook (C2-D: sunrise 3 on 'chase', C01's first frame, then the hold). The Short's own 9:16 keys render from the BLOCK916 composition as before.

LE3.title: the final chorus, full frame: one continuous orbital move over her night network, across the gold line, the tiny machine

le3._doc: her-centre keys (tR 0) like chorus 1's L3: az/el = the lens's place round her (deg), la = ln(distance in Earth radii), sx/sy = where her centre sits on screen, fov deg. Sun angle: THETA ~69 deg at L3 (az AZ3 ~ -36); this move starts 55 deg further round on her night side and ends 8 deg past L3, so the gold line enters from the right and crosses. FIRST PASS: check on the first GPU stills (render_le.sh stills LE3) before the full render.

LE3.spin_note: le_gpu, Nov 7: the final-chorus block's earth.spin keys are the blocking's own dive choreography (18 -> -20 in 1.5 beats at bar 7.2, then a 147 deg step to COUNTDOWN_SPIN at bar 9.3, meant to happen inside the cloud deck). In the orbital they showed as a 38 deg whip at 175.5-176.7 s and a hard pop at 180.67 s (frame 5420->5421, mean diff 15-26/255). A Living Earth shot with `spin` holds that value (deg, the same unit as the sections' earth.spin) for its whole length; 18 is the value the shot had for its first 21.5 s (the stills the CD saw at 154/162/170 s). Only the geography of the last 10 s changes.
